purpose: Elevation sources approved for grading the bicycle routing graph, beside the Copernicus sources of map-platform/config/topography-source-policy-v2.json. Offline maps and the map-platform image do not read this file.

terrain.title: USGS 3D Elevation Program, 1/3 arc-second seamless DEM
terrain.coverage: Conterminous United States: the posts inside the area, from the cells that touch it
terrain.areaSource: OpenStreetMap relation 148838 version 1054 of 2026-11-11, the boundary of the United States with its territorial sea, cut to longitudes -126 to -65 and latitudes 23 to 51. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
terrain.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.
terrain.modifications: Cut to the area, resampled from 1/3 to 1 arc-second posts, rounded to whole metres, and joined to Copernicus GLO-30 opened by a grey-scale morphological opening, whose posts are lifted to meet 3DEP over 16 posts at the edge of 3DEP's data. Not endorsed by the USGS.
